title: Leave Management
subtitle: Leave requests, approvals, balances and leave types across the organization.
teamSubtitle: Leave of your team: requests, approvals, balances and calendar.
demoDataNote: Demo data — fictional employees and example leave rules (not an official policy).

kpis.label: Leave key figures
kpis.totalHint: Submitted requests starting this year (drafts excluded).
kpis.pendingHint: Requests waiting for a decision. Their days are reserved in the balances.
kpis.onLeaveHint: Employees on approved leave today (a working day of their schedule) — the same figure Attendance shows.
kpis.daysUsedHint: Working days of approved leave this year.

monthly.title: Monthly leave trend
monthly.subtitle: Requests by start month and status

requests.label: Leave requests
requests.search: Search by request number, name or employee number
requests.awaitingHint: Pending requests you may decide. Your own requests are decided by someone else.
requests.awaitingTeamHint: Pending requests of your team. Your own requests are decided by HR.

form.selfOnly: Requests are submitted for yourself (no permission exists to request on behalf of others).
form.reasonHint: Visible only to you and to the approvers.
form.documentRequired: Required for this leave type. Simulated: only the file name and size are kept.
form.documentSimulated: Optional. Simulated: only the file name and size are kept; nothing is uploaded.
form.summaryHint: Choose a leave type and dates to see the days and your balance.
form.notEnough: Not enough balance for this request.
form.autoApproved: Request {{number}} approved (this leave type needs no approval).

decide.approveText: {{name}} — {{days}}. The days become used, and Attendance shows them as "On leave".
decide.reasonHint: Required. The employee sees this reason.
decide.cancelApprovedText: The days are restored to the balance and Attendance no longer shows them as leave (past days without a check-in become absences).

details.title: Request
details.snapshotNote: As recorded when the request was created.
details.restricted: Visible only to the employee and the approvers
details.attendanceNote: Approved leave: these days appear as "On leave" in Attendance.
details.draftNote: Draft: only you can see it. Submit it to send it for approval.
details.notFound: This leave request does not exist.
details.forbidden: This leave request is outside your access.

balances.title: Leave balances
balances.formula: Remaining = allocated − used − pending. Pending requests reserve days; rejection or cancellation releases them.
balances.search: Search by name or employee number
balances.historyHint: Every change to the balance, oldest first.
balances.forbidden: This employee's leave is outside your access.

calendar.title: Leave calendar
calendar.empty: No approved or pending leave this month.
calendar.loadError: The calendar could not be loaded.

reports.title: Leave reports
reports.balancesNote: Balances of {{year}} (the year of the start date).

types.label: Leave types
types.policyNote: Leave rules here are configurable examples for the demo — not an official or legal leave policy.
types.codeHint: Unique, e.g. ANNUAL. Letters, digits and hyphens.
types.hasMaxConsecutive: Limit the days of one request
types.eligibilityHint: Checked by the system when a request is made.
types.inactiveNote: Inactive: no new requests can use this type. Existing requests and balances keep it.
types.confirmDeactivateText: Employees can no longer request this type. Existing requests and balances are kept.
types.notFound: This leave type does not exist.

profile.ownOnly: You can only see your own leave.

validation.codeFormat: Use capital letters, digits and single hyphens.
validation.dayRange: Enter a number of days in the allowed range.
validation.seniorityDays: Enter the extra days for the seniority rule.
validation.endBeforeStart: The end date must be on or after the start date.
validation.crossesYear: A request must stay within one calendar year — split it into two requests.
validation.rangeTooLong: The range is too long for one request.
validation.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
validation.reasonTooShort: Enter a reason of at least 5 characters.

serverErrors.duplicateCode: Another leave type already uses this code.
serverErrors.inactiveEmployee: Inactive employees cannot request or receive leave.
serverErrors.notEligible: This leave type is not available for this employee.
serverErrors.beforeHire: The leave starts before the hiring date.
serverErrors.noWorkingDays: There are no working days in this range (per the employee's schedule).
serverErrors.tooManyDays: This leave type allows fewer days per request.
serverErrors.overlap: These dates overlap another pending or approved request.
serverErrors.attendanceRecorded: Attendance (a check-in) is already recorded on one of these days.
serverErrors.documentRequired: Attach the supporting document required for this leave type.
serverErrors.insufficientBalance: Not enough balance for this leave type.
serverErrors.overlapApproved: The employee already has approved leave on these dates.
serverErrors.reportTooLong: Choose a period of at most one year.
serverErrors.stateChanged: This request changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
